basic_profile.bio: A seasoned Redditor who has been around the block a few times. I'm a data analyst from Toronto, Canada, who enjoys diving into niche interests and communities. My main passion lies in counting and tracking unique occurrences, which explains my presence in the 'CountOnceAYear' subreddit. Outside of my job, I have a keen interest in technology and digital trends. When I'm not crunching numbers, I enjoy spending time with my partner and our two cats. I tend to be online mostly in the evenings, typically between 6 PM and midnight Eastern Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in data analysis, having completed a degree in Statistics and worked in the field for over a decade. My expertise extends to programming in Python and R, where I've learned a lot through both formal education and self-teaching.
